project_brief.title: Talky
project_brief.goal: A realtime iOS chat app where users sign up, sign in, exchange instant messages, browse recent conversations, edit their profile, and receive push notifications.

development_stages.stage: Stage 1 — Xcode scaffold and first build
development_stages.product_state: The app runs from the Xcode template and shows the default SwiftUI screen.
need: Create Xcode project from the iOS App template
Explore generated files (TalkyApp.swift, ContentView.swift, Assets)
Run the app on the iPhone simulator
Make a small edit to the default Text and observe the preview/simulator refresh
learn: SwiftUI preview canvas and simulator workflow
development_stages.validation: App builds and launches with the default template view on the simulator.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: No product features yet — establishes the runnable skeleton every later stage builds on.

development_stages.stage: Stage 2 — Static UI with mock data
development_stages.product_state: User can navigate from a welcome screen to login/register screens and browse a chat list, new chat screen, and chat detail screen filled with fake data.
need: Build WelcomeView with navigation to LoginxView and RegisterxView
Implement login/register UI using SecureTextField
Create RecentChatView with hardcoded RecentMessage rows
Create NewChatView with a mock ChatUser list
Create ChatDetailView with sample message bubbles
development_stages.validation: Navigating from Welcome to Register/Login works; chat screens render mock data and the send button updates the local chat bar state.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: The product gains a navigable UI shell: every main screen is reachable, but data is fake.
development_stages.temporary_approach: Use hardcoded arrays instead of Firestore; replaced by real Firebase data in stages 3-4.

development_stages.product_state: User can create an account, sign in, and sign out; the app switches between WelcomeView and RecentChatView based on auth state.
need: Configure Firebase project and add GoogleService-Info.plist
Wire FirebaseManager singleton (Auth, Firestore, Storage)
Implement AuthViewModel register/login/logout against FirebaseAuth
Gate RecentChatView on authViewModel.loggedOut
learn: Error mapping to logMessage and ViewState
development_stages.validation: Registering a new user creates an account and lands in the chat list; logging out returns to WelcomeView.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: The product gains identity: the existing UI now acts on a real authenticated user.
development_stages.temporary_approach: While waiting for the Firebase project, keep a mock session flag in UserDefaults; replaced by FirebaseAuth in this stage.

development_stages.stage: Stage 4 — Realtime messaging and recent conversations
development_stages.product_state: User sees real recent conversations, can select another user from the directory, and can send/receive messages that appear instantly.
need: Implement ChatDetailViewModel fetchMessage() and handleSend() with Firestore
Store ChatMessage documents with fromId/toId/text/timestamp
Implement RecentChatViewModel fetchRecentMessages()
Implement NewChatViewModel fetchAllUser() for the user directory
Wire RecentChatView rows to ChatDetailView
development_stages.validation: Two simulators/devices logged in as different users can chat in real time; the recent list updates with new conversations.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: Core product value: real two-way messaging on top of authenticated identity.
development_stages.temporary_approach: No temporary shortcut here — realtime messaging is the milestone.

development_stages.product_state: User can view their profile, update their profile picture, and change their password.
need: Build ProfileView
Build EditProfileView form with SecureTextField fields
Add ImagePicker and prepare image upload to FirebaseStorage
Call authViewModel.editProfile(email:currPassword:newPassword:newRePassword:)
development_stages.validation: User can change photo and password; updated profile persists after app restart.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: The product adds persistent personal identity: the profile image travels with messages and the recent list.
development_stages.temporary_approach: Temporarily store the picked image in memory (authViewModel.image) and skip upload until FirebaseStorage is configured in this stage.

development_stages.product_state: User receives push notifications for new messages and can open the app from the notification.
need: Register device for remote notifications in AppDelegate
Store FCM token with PushNotificationManager.saveFCM
Send FCM push via PushNotificationManager.sendPushNotification
Polish loading/error states with ViewState and alerts
Clean up chat bubble layout and empty states
learn: FCM HTTP request via URLSession and JSONSerialization
development_stages.validation: With the app in the background, an incoming message triggers a notification; tapping it opens the app.
development_stages.cross_feature_value: The final layer turns the app into a complete messaging product that alerts users outside the app.
development_stages.temporary_approach: Use a hardcoded server key/token snippet for quick testing (as in MainView); replaced by the real FCM token flow. The temporary MainView remains in the repo.
